correctness.rationale: Orthogonality reduces the norm ratio exactly to a weighted collision energy. For nonzero pair sum, \(a^3+b^3=(a+b)^3-3ab(a+b)\) forces the same unordered pair; at zero sum all antipodal pairs collide. The identity \(Q=2S^2-P_4-2R+|g(0)|^4+|B|^2\) was reconstructed term by term. Phase alignment, monotonicity in each antipodal geometric mean, Cauchy--Schwarz, and a quadratic optimization yield the sharp constant and all equality cases. The actual bundled verifier replays the fiber geometry and formula exactly for eleven prime fields.
